sloka: दृश्यन्ते चास्य कर्माणि दुष्कराणि सुरैरपि ।यानि सञ्चिन्त्य भीतोऽहमृश्यमूकं समाश्रितः ॥४-११-७५॥।।
transliteration: dṛśyante cāsya karmāṇi duṣkarāṇi surairapi ।yāni sañcintya bhīto'hamṛśyamūkaṁ samāśritaḥ ॥4-11-75॥।।

translations.english: 'Even gods cannot do what he has done. Thinking of all this and being afraid of him, I have taken refuge at Rishyamuka.
